violations.description: Hardcoded API key credential in configuration file.
violations.evidence: config.py line 4 assigns an API key literal directly to API_KEY.
violations.recommendation: Remove the API key literal from source code and retrieve it dynamically from environment variables.

violations.description: Test step in CI uses an ineffective gate that swallows test failures.
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml line 20 executes pytest || true, preventing test failures from breaking the build.
violations.recommendation: Remove || true from the test step so that failing pytest tests fail the CI run.

violations.description: Deleted secret credentials remain present in git commit history.
violations.evidence: Commit 6bc2197 deleted .env containing SECRET_TOKEN and DB_PASSWORD, leaving credentials accessible in git history.
violations.recommendation: Rotate all exposed credentials and purge the deleted secret file from repository history using git filter-repo or BFG Repo-Cleaner.

violations.description: GitHub Actions workflow is granted write-all permissions.
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml line 7 configures permissions: write-all for the job.
violations.recommendation: Reduce permissions to the minimum scope needed, such as permissions: contents: read.

violations.description: The .gitignore file is unsuitable and missing common Python temporary and environment file patterns.
violations.evidence: .gitignore line 1 contains only .DS_Store, omitting rules for __pycache__/, *.pyc, *.log, and environment files.
violations.recommendation: Expand .gitignore to ignore standard Python generated files, log files, environment files, and virtual environments.

violations.description: Committed generated and temporary files exist in the repository.
violations.evidence: __pycache__/config.cpython-312.pyc and server.log are committed to the repository.
violations.recommendation: Remove __pycache__/ and server.log from git tracking and ensure matching ignore rules are in .gitignore.

violations.description: Application dependencies in requirements.txt are completely unpinned.
violations.evidence: requirements.txt lines 1-2 list flask and requests without any version bounds or pinning.
violations.recommendation: Pin exact or version-constrained dependency specifications in requirements.txt.

violations.description: Imported third-party library PyYAML is missing from dependency manifest.
violations.evidence: app.py line 5 imports yaml (PyYAML) to parse stock data, but pyyaml is not declared in requirements.txt.
violations.recommendation: Add PyYAML with appropriate version pinning to requirements.txt.

violations.description: CI workflow branch triggers do not match the default branch and miss pull request events.
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml line 5 targets pushes to master, whereas the default branch is main, and no pull_request trigger is configured.
violations.recommendation: Update the push trigger branch to main and add pull_request trigger to run CI checks on pull requests.

violations.description: Machine-specific absolute local directory path in configuration.
violations.evidence: config.py line 5 hardcodes a Windows user path DATA_DIR = "C:\\Users\\ahmed\\Desktop\\shop\\data".
violations.recommendation: Configure DATA_DIR using environment variables or a relative path based on the application root.

violations.description: Poor environment separation with DEBUG enabled unconditionally for production.
violations.evidence: config.py line 6 hardcodes DEBUG = True with a comment indicating the file is used on the production server.
violations.recommendation: Read the DEBUG flag from environment variables and default to False for production environments.

violations.description: No linter or code formatter is configured for the project.
violations.evidence: The repository lacks configuration for any Python linter/formatter (such as Ruff, Flake8, or Black) and no linting step is present in CI.
violations.recommendation: Configure a code quality tool such as Ruff in pyproject.toml and add a linting step to the CI pipeline.
